title: Your bed
goals: Sleep in the free bed beside {mate}'s.
starting_code: # Go to the free bed's trunk and sleep.
hints: `sleep` works only beside the trunk at the foot of a free bed, and the free bed is the one below {mate}'s.
One step down puts you beside its trunk.
intro: This is our dormitory! The free bed is the one right beside mine. To sleep, stand beside its trunk, and then sleep.
outro: Good morning! Let us go to the library and find you a school wand of your own.
learned: Now you know that a method may need the right place, and that a program must walk there first.
